ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI — Quick Quests [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description:
Middle-click an ISEKAI quest letter to accept it without opening the quest tab when no decision is needed.
HOW IT WORKS • Accepts only available, unambiguous ISEKAI quests with no pawn selection, multiple options or reward choice. • Opens the normal quest tab when a choice is required, requirements are unmet, or a quest prevents automatic acceptance. • Leaves non-ISEKAI quests and other mouse buttons unchanged.
SETTINGS The shortcut is enabled by default. Toggle it in RimWorld’s Mod Settings. The mod has its own settings and works independently of Balanced Stats.
INSTALLATION RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony and ISEKAI RPG LEVELING. Load after them and any Guild/Creatures add-ons. English and Russian interface text is included. Can be added to or removed from an existing save; this mod stores no colony data.
This feature previously belonged to Balanced Stats & Quick Quests. Update Balanced Stats to 1.2.0 or later before using both mods.
Report problems with reproduction steps, mod versions and your log.
